verdict.rationale: Bolna is confirmed as an open-source project on GitHub ('end-to-end open source production ready framework') and provides dedicated enterprise docs for self-hosting via Docker or Kubernetes on one's own servers. This directly satisfies the platform-engineer's need to self-host the runtime from open-source code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of a successful self-hosted deployment, and more detailed infra/config specifics beyond the doc title.
